en_US: Listing the best three of every town,
it’s That Town, These People!
That town, this town, bringing everyone
together, the Town Channel!

Announcing the top 3 in New Bark Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The wind that blows through the town!
There’s a wind that will suddenly blast
through the town, as residents know.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The weather vanes!
The weather vanes posted around the
town allow us to be proactive in
predicting when the wind will blow
through the town.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Professor Elm’s Laboratory!
Professor Elm’s doing great research on
Pokémon as companions, and so we’re
listing his Lab as splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in
Cherrygrove City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The roar of the waves!
The roar of the waves from the beach to
the west just makes everyone feel good,
doesn’t it?
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The little flower beds!
This town has many little flower beds
scattered around, making the town that
much more beautiful.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Guide Gent!
The first time travelers visit the town,
the Guide Gent comes to show them around
and help them out, and that’s why he’s
our splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Violet City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The arched bridge!
This bridge extends over the river
running through the town, and is so
round it reminds the residents of a drum.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The stylish Pokémon Center!
This Pokémon Center is painted in natural
colors so as to blend in with the
beautiful scenery around it, rather than
standing out. Very stylish!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Sprout Tower!
Sprout Tower is always slowly swaying
back and forth, and it’s the place where
Trainers practice if they’re aiming for
the top! It’s strict, which is why it’s
popular, and that’s why it’s our splendid
number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Azalea Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
FARFETCH’D’s charcoal!
This town is famous for the charcoal that
the FARFETCH’D make with materials they
gather themselves.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
SLOWPOKE Well!
Also known as Rainmaker Well, SLOWPOKE
Well is a popular sightseeing spot.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Kurt!
Kurt is quite the talented Poké Ball
Creator, using old-fashioned techniques.
He’s a great carver, and that’s why he’s
our splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Goldenrod City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Dress-Up Guy!
The gentleman running the Dress-Up
Shop in the tunnel is manly on
the outside, but at heart, he’s kind of
like a little girl. But still, he’s an
all-around nice guy.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Global Terminal!
In the Global Terminal, you can trade
Pokémon with people all around the world,
so it was expected that it would be
quite popular.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Radio Tower!
Transmitting information all over Johto,
the Radio Tower is the number one
magnificent sparkling attraction. And of
course, the show you’re listening to now
is being transmitted from that very
same tower, and that’s why it’s our
splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Olivine City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Olivine Café!
This café on the beach is very famous
around the city for having great food.
Everything on the menu is delicious!
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Fast Ship S.S. Aqua!
The S.S. Aqua moves using a jet of water
and is a great resource to travelers
going between Johto and Kanto!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Lighthouse!
This Lighthouse is a shining symbol of
Olivine and lights the way for ships on
the sea, and that’s why it’s our splendid
number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Ecruteak City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Burned Tower!
The large hole burned into this tower
stands as a reminder of its long, yet sad
legacy. But it’s still garnering people’s
interest.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Ecruteak Dance Theater!
You can always hear strains of elegant
music coming from this dance theater,
which is very popular with tourists. It’s
overflowing with charm that will make you
want to get up and dance!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Bellchime Trail!
The trail to the Bell Tower is always
decorated in shades of autumn for some
reason, and is quite the
magnificent sight!
Regular people are not allowed to
enter, but it is still very popular, and
that’s why it’s our splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Cianwood City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Pharmacy!
This Pharmacy has been in business for
500 years, can you believe it? For 500
years, they’ve been doing the same
business!
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
Catching KRABBY on the beach!
When you break rocks on the beach,
sometimes KRABBY will gather. When that
happens, many people will try to catch
the KRABBY.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Guide Lady!
This lady will guide you to the path
leading to the Safari Zone with her
rhythmical way of speaking. She’s very
popular among the locals, and that’s why
she’s our splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Mahogany Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The fire lookout points!
They learned their lesson from the fire
that happened in nearby Ecruteak City,
and constructed fire lookout points,
which ended up at number three on our
list! Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
Their famous RageCandyBars!
What clever souvenirs! We don’t know if
these are delicious or not, but for some
reason we bought one anyway! That’s the
power of a RageCandyBar!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The strange souvenir shop!
They’re not selling anything special, so
what’s with these customers in black
clothes entering and leaving all
day long?
It’s a strange souvenir shop, and our
station was mysteriously flooded with
votes for it, so that’s why it’s our
splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Blackthorn City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Dragon’s Den!
I thought this would be much fancier...
It’s a place that is off-limits to most,
you’ve got to have a special invitation
to enter...
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Ice Path!
Near the town is an entrance to the Ice
Path, from which a cool wind always blows.
It’s a nice place to spend time, which is
why it’s such a popular spot!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Move Deleter and Tutor House!
The Move Deleter and Tutor House
is a great place for Trainers who like to
teach their Pokémon new moves and have
them forget old ones, and that’s why
it’s our splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Pallet Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
Red’s House!
Red is currently out on a journey and
has been away from his house for a while,
but his house is still our number three!
I wonder where he’s gone...
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
Blue’s House!
The Trainer Blue has some real ability,
and is said not to lose to Red, which is
why he is in our number two position!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Professor Oak’s Laboratory!
Of course, if you’re talking about Pallet
Town, you can’t leave out the premier
Pokémon research facility, Professor
Oak’s Laboratory! It’s only natural
that this would be our number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Viridian City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The streetlights!
Not normally a stand-out feature, but in
this small city when it becomes evening,
the streetlights light up and add a
beautiful air to the town.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
Viridian Gym!
This Gym’s trick is to have four different
types of neon lighting up the floor, which
gives the Gym a beautiful glow.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Trainer House!
Viridian’s newest attraction that’s
drawing attention is the Trainer House.
It’s where you can battle Trainers
you’ve connected to with your
Pokéwalker, and that’s why it’s our
splendid number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Pewter City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The huge flower bed!
The beauty of the flowers in this flower
bed bring a certain warmth to the hearts
of all the town’s residents.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The traveling grandpa!
Sometimes when he’s out on a journey,
he’ll find some strange things. This
travel-loving grandpa has landed our
number two spot!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Museum of Science!
This incredibly popular museum has the
knowledge of how to restore ancient
Fossils, and that’s why it’s our number
one! Congratulations!

Announcing the top 3 in Cerulean City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Bike Shop!
This comes in as our number three, but
there has been some gossip that it will
be turned into a shop selling
inflatable tubes. We wonder if there’s
any truth to that?
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Nugget Bridge!
Together with the high cape, this is a
very popular date spot.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Cerulean Cave!
Only those who have defeated every Gym
in Kanto are allowed to enter this cave!
That’s why everyone’s aching to enter,
and that’s why it’s our splendid
number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Lavender Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Name Rater!
This gentleman who can give our beloved
Pokémon even better names slipped into
our number three!
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Kanto Radio Tower!
Not quite as impressive as the Radio
Tower in Goldenrod, but still impressive
in it’s own right. No wonder everyone
likes the radio so much!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The House of Memories!
For Pokémon that lived their lives to
the fullest with their trusted Trainers.
We’ve polled all the Pokémon fans
out there, and this was overwhelmingly
voted number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Vermilion City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The construction site!
There may only be an old man here with
MACHOP, smoothing out the dirt, but this
lot has spent so much time vacant,
without any sign of building, that it has
become quite famous in Vermilion for
some reason.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
Vermilion Pier Gate!
The pier gate at the boat dock has
this floor you can see through to the
sea below it.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Pokémon Fan Club!
Of course this would be number one! And
once the President of the fan club hears
it, he’ll talk anyone’s ear off about it,
won’t he!

Announcing the top 3 in Celadon City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Celadon Condominiums!
These condominums are very popular.
Not only popular enough for number three
on our list, but also popular enough for
GAME FREAK to move in!
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Eatathon!
The Eatathon event held periodically
at the restaurant in Celadon is so
popular that people come from as far
away as the Sinnoh region just
to compete!
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
The Celadon Department Store!
From the old to the young, this
department store is the middle of social
life, and it received an overwhelming
number of votes to become number one!

Announcing the top 3 in Fuchsia City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Fuchsia City Gym!
The first Gym Leader Koga went on to
become one of the Elite Four and left the
Gym in his daughter Janine’s care.
Her doing her daughterly duty seems
to be where the votes come from.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Pal Park!
Oh, this is unexpected, isn’t it! I was
sure this would be number one, but the
Pal Park has finished in second place.
So what’s in first place? Ta-da!
The trio of AIPOM!
I see! It seems that everyone really
loves the Pal Park Warden’s prized
three AIPOM that live with him!

Announcing the top 3 in Cinnabar!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The volcano!
Since that day when the volcano erupted
and washed away the town, the mouth of
the volcano is still open.
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
...
...
...Huh?
There’s no number two?
...What?
There’s no number one either?
Well, I guess that makes sense. I expect
as they rebuild the town, new popular
places will pop up. We’ll be watching over
Cinnabar, just waiting to see what
will happen!

Announcing the top 3 in Saffron City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
Mr. Psychic!
This is the psychic gentleman everyone in
town knows and calls Mr. Psychic!
Moving on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Fighting Dojo!
It’s said that the Dojo owner is a
Karate King. This Dojo is a place for
Trainers who love battle to gather
and converse.
And the number one thing is... Ta-da!
Silph Co.!
This was just as expected, wasn’t it?
As you may know, Silph Co. produces all
kinds of inventions and home appliances,
and that’s why it’s our splendid
number one!
